question: Can Saturn converge on one project, artifact, runtime and extension model without adding compatibility abstractions?
hypothesis: If repository invariants are made explicit and contradictory legacy descriptions are removed or superseded, agents can reconstruct the architecture from a small causal record instead of PR history.
evidencePlan: usegit causal-history workflow on the exact Git tree

negativeKnowledge.hypothesis: Production runtime should track Git source/release refs directly
negativeKnowledge.condition: BuildArtifact is the deployment unit and engineering/CI owns source tooling

negativeKnowledge.hypothesis: Saturn should keep an installation-scoped extension store as the default extensibility model
negativeKnowledge.condition: Registry items can be copied as typed project-owned source

negativeKnowledge.hypothesis: A Saturn-specific project manifest/database is needed
negativeKnowledge.condition: package.json plus src/plant.ts provide identity and conventional entrypoint

validity: Applies to the v0.1 architecture line beginning at refactor/conventions-first.
